First, 49 weeks and 7 days = 49 weeks + 1 week = 50 weeks.  
50 weeks = 50 × 7 = 350 days.  
Subtract 350 days from 1618-09-22.  

1618 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1618 not divisible by 4).  
September has 30 days, so going back:  
From 1618-09-22 subtract 22 days → 1618-09-00 invalid, so better to subtract full months.  

Instead, subtract 350 days stepwise:  
Subtract 1 year (365 days) from 1618-09-22 → 1617-09-22, but that’s too much (we only need to subtract 350 days).  
We subtracted 365, need to add back 15 days: 1617-09-22 + 15 days = 1617-10-07.  

Check: 350 days before 1618-09-22:  
From 1618-09-22 back to 1618-01-01 is 265 days (22 days in Sep not counted yet? Let’s compute exactly):  

Days from 1618-01-01 to 1618-09-22:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 22 →  
31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+22 = 265 days into the year.  

So 1618-09-22 is day 265 of 1618.  
Subtract 350 days: go to previous year 1617, day number = 265 − 350 + 365 = 280.  

Day 280 of 1617 (non-leap):  
Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120), May 31 (151), Jun 30 (181), Jul 31 (212), Aug 31 (243), Sep 30 (273), Oct 7 (280).  

So 280th day = 1617-10-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1617-10-07
